summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch reported that Ned Donnelly had the outfit of Tom Allen's saloon attached over a $125 claim after Allen struck him, and that Allen would open a new saloon at 611 Fifth Street.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'St. Louis Dispatch, Wednesday Evening, April 12, 1876'; pre-1878 Dispatch filed as St. Louis Evening Dispatch per rubric

facts.fact: Ned Donnelly claimed $125 from Allen for five lessons at $25 each; when Allen struck him, Donnelly had a constable attach the outfit of Allen's saloon, and the counters and bottles were hauled away
Allen was expected to open another saloon at 611 Fifth Street within a few days, and said he never intended to return to England
Allen dismissed a Philadelphia report that Joe Goss had come to America to challenge him, saying he would accept a challenge from Goss or anyone for as big stakes as desired
